module: Flowgraph node "Load Drag Race Data" (category once_instant). Loads and initializes the drag race data from a file (filepath pin), normally once at the start of the mission, via gameplay_drag_dragBridge.loadDragDataForMission. Outputs: flow (pulse) and success.

workOnce.desc: Loads the data, checks getData() and sets a node error on failure; always activates flow.
